title: A Leech Drinks 5x Its Own Weight in Blood, Then Fasts for Months

scenes.text: This animal drinks five times its own weight in blood.
It's a leech, and one meal can take up to several hours.
Some experts say it can swell to seven or eight times its size.
Its stomach stores the blood and releases it very slowly.
One good meal can keep it alive for months.
Five times its weight. Then nothing for months.

description:
This animal drinks five times its own weight in blood.
A leech stores the blood in its stomach and digests it slowly, so one meal can last for months.
Would you rather meet a leech or a mosquito? Comment below.
first_comment: Some leech species can go a year or longer without another meal. Would you survive that?
